schema.name: ivoa
schema.description: Definition and support code for the ObsCore data model and table.

table.name: ivoa.obscore
table.title: Unnamed data center Obscore Table
table.description: The IVOA-defined obscore table, containing generic metadata for datasets within this data centre.

column.name: dataproduct_type
column.description: High level scientific classification of the data product, taken from an enumeration

column.name: dataproduct_subtype
column.description: Data product specific type

column.name: calib_level
column.description: Amount of data processing that has been applied to the data

column.name: obs_collection
column.description: Name of a data collection (e.g., project name) this data belongs to

column.name: obs_id
column.description: Unique identifier for an observation

column.name: obs_title
column.description: Free-from title of the data set

column.name: obs_publisher_did
column.description: Dataset identifier assigned by the publisher.

column.name: obs_creator_did
column.description: Dataset identifier assigned by the creator.

column.name: access_url
column.description: The URL at which to obtain the data set.

column.name: access_format
column.description: MIME type of the resource at access_url

column.name: access_estsize
column.description: Estimated size of data product

column.name: target_name
column.description: Object a targeted observation targeted

column.name: target_class
column.description: Class of the target object (star, QSO, ...)

column.name: s_ra
column.description: RA of (center of) observation, ICRS

column.name: s_dec
column.description: Dec of (center of) observation, ICRS

column.name: s_fov
column.description: Approximate spatial extent for the region covered by the observation

column.name: s_region
column.description: Region covered by the observation, as a polygon

column.name: s_resolution
column.description: Best spatial resolution within the data set

column.name: t_min
column.description: Lower bound of times represented in the data set

column.name: t_max
column.description: Upper bound of times represented in the data set

column.name: t_exptime
column.description: Total exposure time

column.name: t_resolution
column.description: Minimal significant time interval along the time axis

column.name: em_min
column.description: Minimal wavelength represented within the data set

column.name: em_max
column.description: Maximal wavelength represented within the data set

column.name: em_res_power
column.description: Spectral resolving power lambda/delta lambda

column.name: o_ucd
column.description: UCD for the product's observable

column.name: pol_states
column.description: List of polarization states in the data set

column.name: facility_name
column.description: Name of the facility at which data was taken

column.name: instrument_name
column.description: Name of the instrument that produced the data

column.name: s_xel1
column.description: Number of elements (typically pixels) along the first spatial axis.

column.name: s_xel2
column.description: Number of elements (typically pixels) along the second spatial axis.

column.name: t_xel
column.description: Number of elements (typically pixels) along the time axis.

column.name: em_xel
column.description: Number of elements (typically pixels) along the spectral axis.

column.name: pol_xel
column.description: Number of elements (typically pixels) along the polarization axis.

column.name: s_pixel_scale
column.description: Sampling period in world coordinate units along the spatial axis

column.name: em_ucd
column.description: Nature of the product's spectral axis (typically, em.freq, em.wl, or em.energy)

column.name: preview
column.description: URL of a preview (low-resolution, quick-to-retrieve representation) of the data.

column.name: source_table
column.description: Name of a TAP-queriable table this data originates from. This source table usually provides more information on the the data than what is given in obscore. See the TAP_SCHEMA of the originating TAP server for details.

schema.name: tap_schema
schema.description: Unnamed data center's Table Access Protocol (TAP) service with table metadata.

column.name: schema_name
column.description: Fully qualified schema name

column.name: table_name
column.description: Fully qualified table name

column.name: table_type
column.description: One of: table, view

column.name: description
column.description: Brief description of the table

column.name: utype
column.description: utype if the table corresponds to a data model

column.name: table_index
column.description: Suggested position this table should take in a sorted list of tables from this data center

column.name: sourcerd
column.description: Id of the originating rd (local information)

column.name: nrows
column.description: The approximate size of the table in rows

table.name: tap_schema.columns
table.description: Columns in tables available for ADQL querying.

column.name: table_name
column.description: Fully qualified table name

column.name: column_name
column.description: Column name

column.name: description
column.description: Brief description of column

column.name: unit
column.description: Unit in VO standard format

column.name: ucd
column.description: UCD of column if any

column.name: utype
column.description: Utype of column if any

column.name: datatype
column.description: ADQL datatype

column.name: arraysize
column.description: Arraysize in VOTable notation

column.name: xtype
column.description: VOTable extended type information (for special interpretation of data content, e.g., timestamps or points)

column.name: "size"
column.description: Legacy length (ignore if you can).

column.name: principal
column.description: Is column principal?

column.name: indexed
column.description: Is there an index on this column?

column.name: std
column.description: Is this a standard column?

column.name: sourcerd
column.description: Id of the originating rd (local information)

column.name: column_index
column.description: 1-based index of the column in database order.

table.name: tap_schema.schemas
table.description: Schemas containing tables available for ADQL querying.

column.name: schema_name
column.description: Fully qualified schema name

column.name: description
column.description: Brief description of the schema

column.name: utype
column.description: utype if schema corresponds to a data model

column.name: schema_index
column.description: Suggested position this schema should take in a sorted list of schemas from this data center.

table.name: tap_schema.keys
table.description: Foreign key relationships between tables available for ADQL querying.

column.name: key_id
column.description: Unique key identifier

column.name: from_table
column.description: Fully qualified table name

column.name: target_table
column.description: Fully qualified table name

column.name: description
column.description: Description of this key

column.name: utype
column.description: Utype of this key

column.name: sourcerd
column.description: Id of the originating rd (local information)

table.name: tap_schema.key_columns
table.description: Columns participating in foreign key relationships between tables available for ADQL querying.

column.name: key_id
column.description: Key identifier from TAP_SCHEMA.keys

column.name: from_column
column.description: Key column name in the from table

column.name: target_column
column.description: Key column in the target table

column.name: sourcerd
column.description: Id of the originating rd (local information)

table.name: tap_schema.groups
table.description: Columns that are part of groups within tables available for ADQL querying.

column.name: table_name
column.description: Fully qualified table name

column.name: column_name
column.description: Name of a column belonging to the group

column.name: column_utype
column.description: utype the column within the group

column.name: group_name
column.description: Name of the group

column.name: group_utype
column.description: utype of the group

column.name: sourcerd
column.description: Id of the originating rd (local information)

schema.name: bench
schema.title: tap-compare ObsCore corpus
schema.description: The benchmark's canonical ObsCore corpus (exported from egernia's ivoa.obscore view), published into DaCHS's ivoa.obscore exactly the way the DaCHS documentation publishes an obscore-shaped table: the //obscore#publishObscoreLike mixin, whose parameters default to the same-named columns this table deliberately carries.
